command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64) WANT=183;; x86_64) WANT=62;; *) WANT=unknown;; esac
EM=$(od -An -tu1 -j18 -N2 "$(command -v bwa-mem2)" | awk '{print $1 + $2*256}')
echo "e_machine $EM  want $WANT ($(uname -m))"
test "$EM" -eq "$WANT"
mkdir -p /var/tmp/w
tar -xf mem2-index.tar -C /var/tmp/w
ln -sf /tmp/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.alt /var/tmp/w/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa.alt
IDX=/var/tmp/w/GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa
ls -l "$IDX.0123" "$IDX.bwt.2bit.64" | awk '{print $5,$9}'
VER=$(bwa-mem2 version 2>/dev/null | awk 'END{print $NF}' || true)
# The aligner writes plain SAM to the container disk and nothing else is timed: a `| gzip`
# downstream of 16 threads times the compressor (BusyBox gzip on the x86 images), not the aligner.
mkdir -p /var/tmp/w
SAM=/var/tmp/w/aln.sam
T0=$(date +%s)
bwa-mem2 mem -t 16 -R '@RG\tID:SRR062634\tSM:HG00096\tPL:ILLUMINA' "$IDX" SRR062634_1.filt.fastq.gz SRR062634_2.filt.fastq.gz > "$SAM" 2> run.log
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
ALTN=$(awk 'tolower($0) ~ /read [0-9]+ alt contigs/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if(tolower($i)=="read"){print $(i+1); exit}}' run.log)
NREC=$(grep -vc '^@' "$SAM" || true)
NSQ=$(awk '/^@SQ/{n++} !/^@/{exit} END{print n+0}' "$SAM")
BYTES=$(stat -c%s "$SAM")
{ echo "tool              bwa-mem2"
  echo "wall_s            $WALL  (the aligner only)"
  echo "threads           16"
  echo "alt_contigs_read  $ALTN  want >0 (the analysis set must be used ALT-aware)"
  echo "sam_records       $NREC  want exactly 48817006"
  echo "sq_lines          $NSQ  want >0 (a SAM header, not just records)"
  echo "sam_bytes         $BYTES"
  echo "version           $VER  (what the binary reports; the package is labelled 2.3)"
  echo "kernel            $(awk '/^Executing in/{print $3}' run.log)"
  echo "reads_per_s       $(( 48297986 / WALL ))"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$NSQ" -gt 0
test "$ALTN" -gt 0
# bwa-mem2 documents output identical to bwa mem, so this is an exact cross-implementation
# identity on identical bytes, not a band. A mismatch is a finding, so print the delta first.
if [ "$NREC" != "48817006" ]; then echo "DELTA vs bwa: $(( NREC - 48817006 )) records"; fi
test "$NREC" = '48817006'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
